purpose: 第六轮（V6）新增的外部素材与参考资料。V3–V5 的素材见同目录 downloaded_models.json、GSI_Layout_Sources.txt、Reference_Links.txt。

models.title: Escalator / Эскалатор KONE TravelMaster 110
models.author: Sergey Burov (@s-burov)
models.downloaded_file: escalator-kone-travelmaster-110.zip (7 021 351 bytes), contains source/Sketchfab_2017_03_17_17_50_11.blend and one stainless texture

changes: modules assembled to a 4 m rise (top and bottom modules plus three 1 m middle modules, 30 degrees)
all parts merged into one mesh
materials replaced by the scene's stainless steel, rubber, glass and step-edge materials; the original texture is not used
placed 30 times by collection instancing (collection 'V6 escalator master', excluded from the view layer)
models.note: Artist model of a KONE TravelMaster 110; the escalators at Tokyo station are not claimed to be this product.

illustrative_content: the route map is a schematic of major stations, not the official JR map
car numbers (形式番号) on the commuter cars use plausible type prefixes and set numbers, not a real roster
Shinkansen side-display wording, seat-class layout and the N700 lamp position are approximations
